newsitem.title: USA: Marine Drilling plans 5 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Marine Drilling plans 5 mln share offering.

text.p: Marine Drilling said it plans to offer five million shares of common stock pursuant to a shelf registration statement it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission and subject to market conditions.

The company currently has about 45.7 million shares of common stock outstanding. As a result, the number of outstanding shares will increase by about 11 percent, to about 50.7 million shares outstanding.
